name: auth_sdk
_comment: The auth module's Next.js half (deliveryplatform wave). Carries the whole NextAuth surface a shell needs to authenticate against the platform: the app/(auth) route group (credentials login/register/forgot-password + the [...nextauth] handler), the always-paas PaaSLogin form, the drizzle/Postgres persistence the credential flow writes to (db/, lib/drizzle/, drizzle.config.ts), and the four seam files it overwrites in the host: middleware.ts (NextAuth-gated), app/lib/session.ts (NextAuth-backed session seam), app/services/control/global_settings.ts (drizzle-backed GlobalSettings store) and components/custom/session-provider.tsx (the client-side next-auth/react SessionProvider wrapper that base_sdk's useSession() callers - app-sidebar.tsx, nav/team-switcher.tsx - need mounted above them; the host's own app/layout.tsx imports it and wraps <body> children with it, exactly as RokctAI_frontend's layout does). The bare shell commits neutral no-auth copies of those seams (for session-provider.tsx a pass-through that just renders children), so it builds green without this SDK; composing auth_sdk swaps in the real implementations. The root route app/(chat)/page.tsx is owned by agent_sdk (its installer copies the whole app/(chat) group), not by this SDK.

integrations._comment: The drizzle migration scripts travel with the drizzle config/schema this SDK installs; the bare shell's package.json carries neither. Inserted after the host's lint script line (idempotent: skipped when already present).
